player_stats_scale_pct: Label of the setting that sizes the statistics overlay.
player_stats_scale_pct_hint: Desktop and console: the overlay scales on top of the OS display scaling.
player_pad_speaker_volume: Label of the slider on a controller card's menu in the Controllers screen; 0 to 100 %.
player_pad_speaker_volume_hint: Foot of that menu while the slider is focused; 100 % is the level the game sends.
prefs_advanced_changed: Row at the end of a settings category while advanced settings are hidden; count is how many of them differ from a fresh install. Activating it shows them.
dial_approve_no_pin: Under 'Waiting for approval…'. host: the host's name.
dial_connect_failed: Banner or toast after a failed connect. reason: a sentence saying why, from another message or from the host.
dial_connecting: Headline or button while a connection is being made and no host name is shown.
dial_connecting_detail: Under the connecting headline while the handshake runs.
dial_connecting_to: Headline of the connect card. host: the host's or game's name.
dial_host_reason: A failure line that names its host. host: the host's name; reason: a whole sentence saying why.
dial_identity_rejected: A reason, shown alone or after 'Couldn't connect —'; no final period by design.
dial_no_answer: A reason, shown after 'Couldn't connect —'; no final period by design.
dial_session_access_violation: log: the path of the client's log file.
dial_session_exception: code: the exception code in hex, e.g. 0xC0000409; log: the path of the client's log file.
dial_session_exception_no_path: For a client that writes no log file, so no path to name. code: the exception code in hex, e.g. 0xC0000409.
dial_session_exit_code: code: the process exit code; log: the path of the client's log file.
dial_session_exit_code_no_path: For a client that writes no log file, so no path to name. code: the process exit code.
dial_stop_waiting: Hint on the wake card when no connect follows.
dial_stream_start_failed: The stream did not start on a console client (Switch, PS5); the cause goes to the log.
dial_timed_out: A reason, shown after 'Couldn't connect —'; no final period by design.
dial_wake_parked: Headline when a woken host didn't come online in time. host: the host's name.
dial_waking: Headline while a host wakes. host: its name.
dial_waking_progress: Under 'Waking {host}…'. seconds: whole seconds waited so far.
error_request_failed: A request for access failed with no reason from the host.
error_save_failed: A change to the saved hosts was not written to disk. reason: the file error, English.
hosts_add_confirm: Button that saves a new host.
hosts_add_title: Title of the form that adds a host by address.
hosts_clipboard: Switch in the host form: copy and paste between this device and the host.
hosts_clipboard_hint: Under the shared-clipboard switch in the host form.
hosts_edit_title: Title of the form that edits a saved host.
hosts_error_address_invalid: Under the address field of the add-host form. address: what was typed.
hosts_error_mac_invalid: Under the Wake-on-LAN field of the host form. mac: the first entry that isn't one, as typed.
hosts_error_port_invalid: Under the port field of the add-host form. port: what was typed.
hosts_field_address: Label of the host's address field.
hosts_field_address_placeholder: Placeholder in the empty address field.
hosts_field_mac: Label of the field holding the host's MAC address(es) for waking it.
hosts_field_mac_placeholder: Placeholder in the empty MAC field.
hosts_field_name: Label of the host's display-name field.
hosts_field_name_placeholder: Placeholder in the empty name field.
hosts_field_port: Label of the host's port field.
link_ambiguous_host: A link named a host by a name two saved hosts share. name: the name from the link.
link_ambiguous_preset: preset: the preset name from the link.
link_confirm_asks: host: the saved host's name; address: its address.
link_confirm_launch: game: the game id or title the link names.
link_confirm_title: Title of the question before a link that names a host by a guessable name connects.
link_copied: Toast after a host's or game's link went to the clipboard.
link_error_param_too_long: param: the link parameter's name as it stands in the URL (host-ref, launch, preset, as, name). Never translated.
link_error_unknown_route: A link named an action Punktfunk doesn't know. route: the action word from the link, as written.
link_refused_title: Title of the notice that says why a link did nothing.
link_route_unsupported: route: the link's action word (connect, wake, browse) as written.
link_unknown_host: A link named a host this device doesn't know. name: the name or address from the link.
link_unknown_preset: preset: the preset name from the link.
pair_action: Button that pairs with the typed PIN.
pair_device_code: Under 'Approve this device…' while a device waits. code: sixteen hex digits in four groups, the code the host's web console shows for this request.
pair_device_name: Label of the field naming this device for the host.
pair_device_name_placeholder: Placeholder in the empty device-name field.
pair_no_pin_hint: Beside the request-access button on the pairing screen.
pair_paired: Toast after pairing. host: the host's name.
pair_pairing: The pair button while the ceremony runs.
pair_pin_placeholder: Placeholder in the empty PIN field.
pair_request_access: Button or row that asks the host's owner to let this device in, with no PIN.
pair_required_title: Title when a host needs pairing before it streams.
pair_saved_failed: Pairing worked but the host list could not be written. reason: the file error, English.
pair_title: Title of the pairing screen. host: the host's name.
pair_use_pin: Button that opens PIN pairing instead of the offered shortcut.
pair_waiting_for_approval: The request is sent; the host's owner has not approved it yet.
profile_getting_ready: Under a profile card while its desktop starts.
profile_gone: The remembered profile was removed. name: that profile's name.
profile_in_use: Under a profile card: someone plays as it, device unknown.
profile_in_use_by: Under a profile card in the picker. device: the name of the device playing as it.
profile_locked: Screen reader label of the lock badge on a profile that needs its password.

profile_title: Title of the profile picker before a connect. host: the host's name.
profile_unavailable: Under a profile card whose desktop can't run now.

profile_waking: Headline while a profile's own desktop starts before a stream. name: the profile's name.
trust_accept: Button: accept the host's certificate as it is and connect.
trust_explain: Under the trust-on-first-use title, above the host's certificate fingerprint.
trust_first_connection: Trust-on-first-use question. address: the host's address and port.
trust_mismatch_title: Title when a saved host's address answers with another identity.
trust_title: Title of the first-connection question for a host that offers trust on first use.
unlock_password: Label of the account password field.
unlock_password_placeholder: Placeholder in the empty password field.
unlock_pin: Label of a locked profile's PIN field.
unlock_pin_digits_a11y: Read by the screen reader for the PIN's dots, after the field's label; never the digits themselves. count: how many digits are typed, 0 to 8.
unlock_pin_error_empty: Under the PIN field: Sign in with nothing typed.
unlock_pin_error_shape: Under the PIN field: what was typed is not 4 to 8 digits.
unlock_pin_intro: Under the PIN prompt's title. host: the host's name.
unlock_pin_placeholder: Placeholder in the empty PIN field.
unlock_sign_in: Button that sends the password or the PIN.
unlock_starting: Progress line after the password is sent, while the profile's desktop starts. host: the host's name.
unlock_stay_signed_in: Switch: the host remembers this device so later connects need no password or PIN.
unlock_title: Title of the password or PIN prompt. name: the profile's name.
unlock_with_biometry: Switch in the password or PIN prompt: enrol this device's key. method: Face ID, Touch ID, Optic ID or Windows Hello (never translated).

player_host_sort_name: Host order option: alphabetical by host name.
player_host_grouping_preset: Group hosts by: the preset each host connects with.
player_host_grouping_status: Group hosts by: online or offline.

hostcard_connect_with: Submenu or picker label: the preset a connect uses.

hostcard_link_copied: Short notice after a host's link went to the clipboard.
hostcard_unpin_card: Menu item on a pinned card (a shortcut to one host with one preset) that removes the card.
hostcard_pin_preset: Switch that adds a card for this host with that preset. {preset} is the preset's name.
hostcard_edit: Menu item that opens the host's name, address and wake settings.
hostcard_remove_title: Confirmation title before a saved host is removed from this device. {host} is its name.
hostcard_pair_first: Shown on a row or page that needs the host to be paired before it works.

hostcard_forget_identity_title: Confirmation title. {host} is the host's name.
hostcard_management_port: Label of the host's management (web API) port number.
hostcard_section_power: Section of a host's page with wake, sleep, restart and shut down.
hostcard_section_logs: Section of a host's page with Send logs to host.
hostcard_section_screen: Section of a host's page that picks which screen this device streams.
screen_own: Row in the host card's Screen section: the device's own virtual screen on the host.
screen_streams: On the host card; screen is the monitor's label as the host sends it.
screen_in_use: Under a greyed monitor row; device is the other device's pairing name.
screen_off: Under a greyed monitor row the host reports disabled.
screen_locked_hint: Shown in place of the Screen section when the host reports locked.
hostcard_resume: Button that connects to a host where a game is already running.
hostcard_send_logs: Menu item that uploads this device's log to the host for a bug report.
hostcard_sending_logs: Notice while the log upload runs. {host} is the host's name.
hostcard_logs_sent_body: Notice after the log upload succeeded. {host} is the host's name. 'Logs' is the name of the web console's page.
hostcard_logs_failed: Notice after the log upload failed. {reason} is an English error from the network layer.
hostcard_speed_test: Menu item that opens the network speed test for this host.
hostcard_action_unavailable: A host action's menu row when the host can't run it now. {action} is the action's name (a host may send its own, untranslated).
hostcard_action_unavailable_body: Notice when a host action can't run now and the host gave no reason. {action} is the action's name.
hostcard_action_asking: Notice while a host action is sent. {action} is the action's name, {host} the host's name.
hostcard_action_sent_body: Notice after the host accepted the action. {host} is the host's name, {action} the action's name.
hostcard_action_failed: Notice after the host refused the action. {action} is the action's name, {reason} an English error.
hostcard_action_confirm_body: Body of the confirmation before restart or shut down. {host} is the host's name.
speedtest_title: Title of the network speed test page or dialog.
speedtest_failed_title: Title when the speed test produced no result. {host} is the host's name.
speedtest_link_carries_body: Speed test result: the measured ceiling. {rate} is a figure with its unit, e.g. '940 Mbit/s'.
speedtest_link_carries_at_least_body: Speed test result when the link was not saturated. {rate} is a figure with its unit.

speedtest_recommended: Short label of the suggested bitrate, in a tile or chart legend.

speedtest_loss: Packet loss, as a tile or row label.
speedtest_use_rate: Button that saves the suggested bitrate as the default. {rate} is a figure with its unit.
speedtest_apply_to_preset: Button that saves the suggested bitrate into a preset. {preset} is its name.
speedtest_set_default: Button that saves the suggested bitrate as the player's default.
speedtest_set_in_preset: Button that saves the suggested bitrate into a preset that has none of its own. {preset} is its name.
speedtest_applied_default: Notice after saving. {rate} is a figure with its unit.
speedtest_applied_preset: Notice after saving. {rate} is a figure with its unit, {preset} the preset's name.
finding_speed_mismatch_body: Network check finding. {host_mbit} and {device_mbit} are whole numbers (link speeds of the two network ports).
finding_speed_mismatch_unknown_body: Network check finding when the port speeds are unknown.
finding_burst_intolerant_body: Network check finding. {loss} is a percentage with one decimal and a '.' decimal point in every language.
finding_receive_buffer_body: Network check finding. {packets} is a whole number of dropped packets, {cap_kb} the buffer limit in kilobytes.
finding_receive_buffer_cap_body: Network check finding. {cap_kb} is the buffer limit in kilobytes.
finding_link_fault_body: Network check finding. {loss} is a percentage with one decimal and a '.' decimal point in every language.
finding_queue_build_up_body: Network check finding. {spread_ms} is whole milliseconds, {max_mbit} whole megabits per second.
finding_host_send_buffer_body: Network check finding. {packets} is a whole number of refused packets.
finding_host_send_buffer_cap_body: Network check finding. {cap_kb} is the host's buffer limit in kilobytes.
finding_wifi_loss_body: Network check finding. {loss} is a percentage with one decimal and a '.' decimal point in every language.
finding_unknown_body: A finding this version doesn't know. {id} is its number.
lib_title: Title of the game-library page and its tab.
lib_title_host: Library page title for one host. {host}: the host's name, or 'host · preset' on a pinned card.
lib_loading: Shown while the host's game list loads.
lib_load_failed: Title of the card shown when the host's game list can't be fetched.

lib_empty: Empty state of a host's library.

lib_no_match_body: {query}: the text the player searched for, as typed.

lib_desktop_action: What selecting the desktop tile does (hint-bar verb or menu row).

lib_section_games: Library section and heading over the game grid.
lib_heading_host: Heading over the desktop tile when no launcher shares its row.

lib_group_store: Grouping option: a group per store.

lib_install_unsupported: Notice when the host is too old to install or remove games from a device.
lib_install_failed: {title}: the game's title. {why}: a lowercase cause phrase (error_mgmt_*).
lib_resume_failed: Resuming a download failed. {title}: the game's title. {why}: a lowercase cause phrase.
lib_pause_failed: Pausing a download failed. {title}: the game's title. {why}: a lowercase cause phrase.
lib_remove_failed: Removing a title's files failed. {title}: the game's title. {why}: a lowercase cause phrase.
lib_download_queued: Download line under a title while other downloads go first.
lib_download_installing: Download line while the host unpacks the files.
lib_download_progress: Part of the download line. {done} and {total}: sizes with their units, e.g. 12.3 GB.
lib_download_so_far: Part of the download line when the total isn't known. {done}: a size with its unit.
lib_download_rate: Part of the download line: the speed. {rate}: a size with its unit, e.g. 48 MB.
lib_download_eta_soon: Part of the download line, after the speed. Lowercase.
lib_download_eta_minutes: Part of the download line. {minutes}: 1–60. Lowercase.
lib_download_eta_hours: Part of the download line. {hours}: 1 or more, {minutes}: 0–59. Lowercase.
lib_download_failed: Why a launch that waited on a download stopped. {title}: the game's title.
lib_download_failed_why: {title}: the game's title. {why}: the sentence the host's plugin sent.
lib_hold_downloading: First part of the launch screen's download line, before the progress.
lib_hold_leaving: Under the download bar on the launch screen.
lib_hold_waiting_window: Launch screen: the game runs and its window isn't up yet.
lib_hold_starting: Launch screen: connected, the host is starting the game.
lib_hold_show_stream: Launch screen button: show the stream now, before the game is up.
lib_hold_show_desktop: Launch screen button after the launch gave up: show the host's desktop.
lib_hold_gave_up_not_started: Launch screen gives up. {title}: the game's title.
lib_hold_gave_up_slow: Launch screen gives up. {title}: the game's title.
lib_hold_gave_up_exited: Launch screen gives up. {title}: the game's title.
lib_hold_ending: Launch screen after the launch gave up: ending the game on the host.
lib_hold_ended: Launch screen: the stuck game was ended. Names the Retry button beside it.
lib_hold_not_running: Launch screen: nothing was left to end.
lib_hold_end_on_host: Launch screen button after the launch gave up: end the stuck game.
error_mgmt_not_paired: Cause phrase after a frame such as 'Couldn't load the library — '. Lowercase, no period.
error_mgmt_pin_mismatch: Cause phrase after a frame's dash. Lowercase, no period.
error_mgmt_refused: Cause phrase after a frame's dash. {code}: the HTTP status number.
error_mgmt_unreachable: Cause phrase after a frame's dash. {why}: the network error as the system words it.
ended_with_reason: Toast when a stream ends. {reason}: an ended_* message or a sentence the host sent.
ended_lost: Why a stream ended: the link died.
ended_closed: Why a stream ended, when no reason came with the close.
ended_lost_reconnecting: Toast when the link died and the app dials again.
link_home_screen: Menu row: pin a shortcut to this host or title on the home screen.
link_launcher_file: Menu row: save a file that launches this host or title.
lib_host_not_saved: Toast when a link can't be made because the host was removed.
ended_unexpected: Why a stream ended: the client's own receive loop failed.
ended_no_codec: Why a stream ended: no codec this device decodes is left. {codec}: a codec name such as HEVC or AV1.
ended_decode_failed: Why a stream ended: the video decoder did not start. {codec}: a codec name such as HEVC or AV1.
ring_group_session: Quick actions catalogue group: actions that end or leave the stream.
ring_group_input: Quick actions catalogue group: keyboard, touch and controller actions.
ring_group_view: Quick actions catalogue group: what is shown on screen (statistics, screens).
ring_group_audio: Quick actions catalogue group: microphone and sound.
ring_group_host: Quick actions catalogue group: the host computer's power actions.
ring_group_shortcuts: Quick actions catalogue group: the player's own key chords.
ring_group_empty: Quick actions catalogue group holding only the entry that empties a slot.
ring_group_resolution: Section header over the Resolution and Refresh rows in the quick actions sheet.
ring_end_game: Quick action: quit the game this device launched, then the stream.
ring_disconnect_linger: Quick action: leave the stream while the game keeps running on the host.
ring_touch_mode: Quick action: step through the touch input modes.
ring_keyboard: Quick action: open the on-screen keyboard.
ring_stats: Quick action: step the statistics overlay.
ring_mic: Quick action: mute or unmute the microphone.
ring_pad: Quick action: show or hide the on-screen controller.
ring_send_text: Quick action: type text and send it to the host.
ring_guide: Quick action: press the host controller's guide (Xbox/PS/Steam) button.
ring_qam: Quick action: open Steam's quick access menu on the host.
ring_pad_mouse: Quick action: the controller moves the host's pointer.
ring_pad_type: Quick action: step the controller type the host emulates for this stream.
ring_stream_mute: Quick action: silence this device's speakers; the host keeps playing.
ring_swap_screens: Quick action on a dual-screen handheld: the two screens trade places.
ring_more: The quick actions ring's centre button: opens the full list.
ring_empty_slot: Catalogue entry that clears a ring slot.
ring_slot_empty: Name of a ring slot with no action in it.
ring_end_stream_short: Short word on a ring disc for End stream. Very little space.
ring_end_game_short: Short word on a ring disc for End game. Very little space.
ring_disconnect_linger_short: Short word on a ring disc for Disconnect, keep the game running. Very little space.
ring_touch_mode_short: Short word on a ring disc for Touch mode. Very little space.
ring_keyboard_short: Short word on a ring disc for Keyboard. Very little space.
ring_stats_short: Short word on a ring disc for Statistics. Very little space.
ring_mic_short: Short word on a ring disc for Microphone. Very little space.
ring_pad_short: Short word on a ring disc for Virtual controller. Very little space.
ring_send_text_short: Short word on a ring disc for Send text. Very little space.
ring_guide_short: Short word on a ring disc for Guide button. Very little space.
ring_qam_short: Short word on a ring disc for Quick access menu (Steam's abbreviation).
ring_pad_mouse_short: Short word on a ring disc for Controller mouse. Very little space.
ring_pad_type_short: Short word on a ring disc for Controller type while it is Automatic.
ring_stream_mute_short: Short word on a ring disc for Mute this stream. Very little space.
ring_swap_screens_short: Short word on a ring disc for Swap screens. Very little space.
ring_host_short: Short word on a ring disc for a host power action. Very little space.
ring_mic_on: State of the Microphone quick action: sending.
ring_mic_muted: State of the Microphone quick action: muted.
ring_pad_on: State of the Virtual controller quick action: shown.
ring_pad_off: State of the Virtual controller quick action: hidden.
ring_pad_mouse_off: State of the Controller mouse quick action: the controller plays the game.
ring_pad_mouse_touchpad: State of the Controller mouse quick action: only the controller's touchpad moves the pointer.
ring_pad_mouse_full: State of the Controller mouse quick action: the whole controller drives the pointer.
ring_pad_type_automatic: State of the Controller type quick action: each controller as itself.
ring_pad_type_other: State of the Controller type quick action: a type picked in settings that the ring does not step through.
ring_stream_mute_off: State of the Mute this stream quick action: sound plays.
ring_scroll_invert_on: State of the Invert scroll direction row in the quick actions sheet.
ring_scroll_invert_off: State of the Invert scroll direction row in the quick actions sheet.
ring_sheet_resolution: Row in the quick actions sheet: the stream's resolution, stepped live.
ring_sheet_refresh: Row in the quick actions sheet: the stream's refresh rate, stepped live.
ring_sheet_native: Value of the Resolution row when the stream runs at the display's own size. {width} and {height} are pixels.
ring_sheet_invert_scroll: Row in the quick actions sheet: flips the scroll direction live.
ring_press_again: Value of an armed row in the quick actions sheet: a second press runs the action.
ring_armed_a11y: Screen reader state of an armed ring button: a second press runs it.
ring_end_stream_confirm: Shown under the ring after the first press on End stream.
ring_end_game_confirm: Shown under the ring after the first press on End game.
ring_host_sleep_confirm: Shown under the ring after the first press on Sleep host.
ring_host_reboot_confirm: Shown under the ring after the first press on Restart host.
ring_host_shutdown_confirm: Shown under the ring after the first press on Shut down host.
ring_host_action_confirm: Shown under the ring after the first press on a host action this client has no words for. {action} is the host's own title for it, untranslated.
ring_end_game_unavailable: Why End game is dimmed in the stream.
ring_mic_unavailable: Why Microphone is dimmed in the stream.
ring_pad_touch_only: Why Virtual controller is dimmed on a device without a touch screen.
ring_pad_not_forwarded: Why the virtual controller, guide and quick access actions are dimmed.
ring_send_text_unavailable: Why Send text is dimmed on a client without the typed-text path.
ring_no_controller: Why Controller mouse or Controller type is dimmed.
ring_controller_only: Why Controller mouse is dimmed: the host grants this device no pointer.
ring_host_not_offered: Why a host power action is dimmed when the host sent no reason.
ring_chord_unknown: Why a custom shortcut is dimmed: it names a key this client cannot send.
ring_pointer_not_allowed: Value of the Invert scroll direction row when the host grants no pointer.
ring_end_game_note: Note under End game in the action picker.
ring_pad_note_touch_only: Note under Virtual controller in the action picker on a device without a touch screen.
ring_pad_note: Note under Virtual controller in the action picker on a touch screen.
ring_send_text_note: Note under Send text in the action picker where this client lacks it.
ring_guide_note: Note under Guide button in the action picker. Xbox, PS and Steam are brand names.
ring_qam_note: Note under Quick access menu in the action picker.
ring_pad_mouse_note: Note under Controller mouse in the action picker.
ring_pad_type_note: Note under Controller type in the action picker: the change lasts for this stream only.
ring_swap_screens_note: Note under Swap screens in the action picker.
ring_stream_mute_note: Note under Mute this stream in the action picker: the host keeps playing.
ring_host_note: Note under each host power action in the action picker.
ring_editor_title: Title of the screen that edits the in-stream quick actions ring.
ring_editor_hint_tap: Under the ring editor on a touch screen only (phones and tablets).
ring_editor_preset_owns: Under the quick actions editor while a preset is being edited.
ring_picker_title: Title of the list that picks one ring slot's action.
ring_editor_shortcuts: Section header in the ring editor: the player's own key chords.
ring_editor_shortcuts_hint: Under the shortcuts list in the ring editor.
ring_shortcut_add: Button in the ring editor: start a new key chord.
ring_reset: Button in the ring editor: back to this platform's default ring, shortcuts removed.
ring_reset_confirm: The reset button after its first press.
ring_shortcut_title: Title of the editor for an existing key chord.
ring_shortcut_new_title: Title of the editor for a new key chord.
ring_shortcut_name: Field label: the shortcut's own name.
ring_shortcut_name_placeholder: Placeholder in the shortcut's name field. Task Manager is an example name.
ring_shortcut_name_optional: Field label where the field has no separate placeholder.
ring_shortcut_modifiers: Header over the modifier toggles (Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Win) in the shortcut editor.
ring_shortcut_modifiers_hint: Explains the modifier toggles in the shortcut editor.
ring_shortcut_key: Label of the key a shortcut ends on.
ring_shortcut_no_key: Shown in the preview while the shortcut has no key yet.
ring_shortcut_preview: Caption under the preview disc in the shortcut editor.
ring_shortcut_pick_key_first: Toast or alert title when saving a shortcut with no key.
ring_shortcut_remove: Destructive button in the shortcut editor.
ring_key_group_function: Group of keys on the shortcut keyboard: Esc and F1 to F12.
ring_key_group_letters: Group of keys on the shortcut keyboard: A to Z.
ring_key_group_numbers: Group of keys on the shortcut keyboard: 0 to 9.
ring_key_group_editing: Group of keys on the shortcut keyboard: Tab, Space, Enter, Backspace, Del, Ins.
ring_key_group_navigation: Group of keys on the shortcut keyboard: Home, End, page and arrow keys.
ring_key_group_other: Group of keys on the shortcut keyboard: Print Screen, Pause, Caps Lock.
ring_slot_clock: Screen reader position of a ring slot, like a clock face. {hour} is 12, 2, 4, 6, 8 or 10.
pad_virtual_title: Section header in the ring editor: the on-screen controller's look.
pad_virtual_layout: Picker label: which controls the on-screen controller has.
pad_virtual_layout_sticks: On-screen controller layout: sticks, bumpers and triggers.
pad_virtual_layout_dpad: On-screen controller layout: the D-pad and the four face buttons.
pad_virtual_opacity: Slider label: how solid the on-screen controller is drawn.
pad_virtual_scale: Slider label: how large the on-screen controller is drawn.
pad_virtual_edit_layout: Button: open the on-screen controller's layout editor.
pad_layout_title: Title of the on-screen controller's layout editor.
pad_layout_editing_upright: Under the layout editor's title while the screen is upright.
pad_layout_editing_wide: Under the layout editor's title while the screen is wide.
pad_layout_reset: Button in the layout editor: every control back to its place.
pad_layout_show: Button in the layout editor: show the selected control again.
pad_layout_hide: Button in the layout editor: hide the selected control.
pad_layout_size: Slider label in the layout editor: the selected control's size.
pad_layout_hint: Layout editor instructions. Touch screens only.
pad_control_left_bumper: Name of an on-screen controller control, read by screen readers and the layout editor.
pad_control_right_bumper: Name of an on-screen controller control.
pad_control_left_trigger: Name of an on-screen controller control.
pad_control_right_trigger: Name of an on-screen controller control.
pad_control_left_stick_click: Name of an on-screen controller control: pressing the left stick in.
pad_control_right_stick_click: Name of an on-screen controller control: pressing the right stick in.
pad_control_left_stick: Name of an on-screen controller control.
pad_control_right_stick: Name of an on-screen controller control.
pad_control_dpad: Name of an on-screen controller control.
pad_control_face: Name of an on-screen controller control: A, B, X and Y together.
pad_control_ring: Name of the on-screen controller's button that opens the quick actions ring.
controls_title: Title of the page listing the keys, gestures and controller chords that work during a stream.
controls_lead: First line of the stream controls page.
controls_group_remote: Group on the stream controls page: a TV remote's keys.
controls_group_keyboard: Group on the stream controls page: key chords.
controls_group_touch: Group on the stream controls page: touch gestures.
controls_group_touch_note: Quiet note beside the Touchscreen group title: the gestures work in these two touch modes. The two names are touch mode options.
controls_group_touch_full: Touchscreen group title with its note, where a client shows them as one line.
controls_group_pad: Group on the stream controls page: controller chords.
controls_group_pad_note: Quiet note beside the Controller group title. {select}, {back} and {view} are controller button names, untranslated: the same button carries each name on different controllers.
controls_group_pad_full: Controller group title with its note, as one line. {select}, {back} and {view} are controller button names, untranslated.
controls_hold: A chord that is held, not pressed. {keys} is the key or button chord, drawn as key badges.
controls_either: Two chords that do the same. {first} and {second} are key chords, drawn as key badges.
controls_gesture_click: A gesture in the stream controls list: click into the stream.
controls_gesture_three_finger_tap: A touch gesture in the stream controls list.
controls_gesture_two_finger_twist: A touch gesture in the stream controls list: two fingers turned like a dial.
controls_gesture_three_finger_swipe_up: A touch gesture in the stream controls list.
controls_gesture_three_finger_swipe_down: A touch gesture in the stream controls list.
controls_cycle_stats: What a chord does: step the statistics overlay through its levels.
controls_cycle_log: What a remote key does: step the log overlay.
controls_open_dial: What a chord or gesture does: open quick actions.
controls_open_menu: What a chord does on the browser client: open its quick actions menu (a list, not a ring).
controls_right_mouse_button: What a remote key does: acts as the right mouse button.
controls_escape_on_host: What a remote key does: sends Escape to the host.
controls_open_disconnect_dialog: What a held remote key does.
controls_release_input: What a chord does on a desktop: hand mouse and keyboard back, or take them again.
controls_disconnect: What a chord does: end the stream.
controls_release_mouse: What a chord does in a browser.
controls_release_mouse_page: What Esc does in a browser.
controls_release_pointer: What a chord does on Android.
controls_capture_mouse_keyboard: What a click into the stream does on a Mac.
controls_release_mouse_keyboard: What a chord does on a Mac.
controls_release_pointer_device: What a chord does on an iPad with a keyboard.
controls_toggle_fullscreen_after: What a chord does on a Mac. {keys} is a key chord. Capture system shortcuts is a setting's name: use its translated label.
controls_guide_hold: Stream controls row: what the guide gesture does on the host's virtual controller.
controls_release_hold_disconnect: What a controller chord does: a press releases input, holding it ends the stream.
controls_hold_disconnect: What a controller chord does when held.
player_shortcuts: Settings row under Input that opens the page of in-stream shortcuts: a button chord, a held button or a key chord, each bound to a quick action.
player_shortcuts_hint: Caption of the Shortcuts settings row.
shortcuts_lead: First line of the Shortcuts page, above its rows.
shortcuts_does: Label of a shortcut's action row: what the shortcut does. Followed by the action's name.
shortcuts_press: Label of a shortcut's trigger row: the buttons or keys to press. Followed by them.
shortcuts_fires_on: Label of the choice between Press and Hold for a shortcut.
shortcuts_fires_press: Option under Fires on: the shortcut acts when the buttons are pressed together and let go.
shortcuts_fires_hold: Option under Fires on: the shortcut acts after the buttons are held for a second.
shortcuts_record: Button: record a shortcut's buttons or keys by pressing them.
shortcuts_record_prompt: Shown while recording a shortcut, until the player lets go of the first button or key.
shortcuts_choose: Button: pick a shortcut's buttons or keys from a grid instead of pressing them.
shortcuts_add: Button at the end of the Shortcuts page: pick an action, then record its buttons or keys.
shortcuts_reset: Button at the end of the Shortcuts page: every shortcut back to this device's defaults.
shortcuts_remove: Button on a shortcut's page: delete this shortcut.
shortcuts_one_button_hold: Shown beside a dimmed Press option when the shortcut is one button: a quick press of it stays the game's.
shortcuts_subset: Why a shortcut is refused. {first} and {second} are button chords, drawn as button badges ("Select + A"): the shorter one acts as soon as it is pressed, so the longer one never happens.
shortcuts_identical_replace: Asked when a new shortcut uses buttons another one already has. {keys} is the chord, drawn as badges ("Hold Start"); {action} is the other shortcut's action name.
shortcuts_not_on_device: Note on a dimmed shortcut whose action this device doesn't have.
shortcuts_fixed: Note on a shortcut row that can't be changed: a touch gesture or a TV remote key.
prefs_group_session: Settings group heading on the General page: starting, waking, fullscreen, background.
prefs_group_statistics: Settings group heading on the General page: the in-stream statistics overlay.
prefs_group_library: Settings group heading on the General page (Apple, Android): library and start screen.
prefs_group_interface: Settings group heading (Android, browser) over the controller interface switch.
prefs_reset_all: Destructive row ending the General settings page, under Default settings only. It opens a confirmation.
prefs_reset_all_hint: Description under the reset row on the General settings page.
prefs_reset_all_title: Heading of the confirmation before every setting goes back to a fresh install's value.
prefs_reset_all_body: Body of that confirmation: what the reset leaves alone.
prefs_group_console: Settings group heading (Linux, Windows) over the controller interface switch.
prefs_group_resolution: Settings group heading on the Display page.
prefs_group_picture: Settings group heading on the Display page: bitrate, codec, HDR, fit.
prefs_group_second_screen: Settings group heading on Android's Display page: a dual-screen handheld's second panel.
player_start_in: Setting label: which screen the app opens on at launch.
player_start_in_hosts: Option of Start in: open on the list of hosts.
player_start_in_library: Option of Start in: open on the default host's game library.
player_start_in_stream: Option of Start in: connect straight to the default host's desktop.
player_start_in_hosts_no_default: Value of Start in when no default host exists, so every option lands on the host list.
player_start_in_library_on: Value of Start in on the console: the Library option and the host it opens. {host}: the host's name.
player_start_in_stream_on: Value of Start in on the console: the Stream option and the host it connects to. {host}: the host's name.
player_start_in_hint: Controller interface only. The host list is the first screen of the app.
player_start_in_host_hint: Shown under Start in when a default host exists. {host}: the host's name. Library and Stream are the option names.
player_start_in_no_host_hint: Shown under Start in while no host is paired or picked as default.
player_auto_wake_hint: Hint under the auto-wake switch. A host behind a VPN can look offline while it is awake.
player_fullscreen: Three-way picker (Mac, Linux): Off, While streaming, Always.
player_fullscreen_stream: Option of Fullscreen: only while a stream runs.
player_background_timeout_minutes: Setting label, followed by a number of minutes: how long a backgrounded session lasts.
player_background_timeout_minutes_count: Option of Disconnect after. {count}: whole minutes (1, 5, 10, 30).
player_background_timeout_minutes_tv_hin: TV variant of the hint: a TV has no battery.
player_stats_verbosity_hint: Compact, Normal and Detailed are this setting's option names.
player_stats_verbosity_cycle_hint: Second line under Statistics overlay. {keys}: the shortcut that cycles the tiers, from the client's shortcut table ("Ctrl+Alt+Shift+S", "⌃⌥⇧S").
player_stats_verbosity_cycle_touch_hint: Touch devices. {keys}: the keyboard or controller shortcut that cycles the tiers ("⌃⌥⇧S", "Select + X").
player_stats_docs_link: A link to the documentation page that explains every statistic.
player_advanced_stats_hint: Moonlight is another streaming product; keep the name. p50/p95 are percentiles; keep them.
player_advanced_stats_docs_hint: Console only, after the hint. {url}: the docs address, never translated.
player_hud_placement_top_leading: Option of Statistics position: a screen corner.
player_exit_hint: Setting label: a one-line hint at stream start that says how to leave the stream.
player_exit_hint_hint: The explanation under the Exit hint setting.
player_gamepad_ui_enabled: Setting label: the switch for the controller interface, a full-screen UI built for a TV and a controller.
player_gamepad_ui_enabled_hint: Hint under the Controller interface switch.
player_gamepad_ui_mode: Setting label right under Controller-optimized UI: when to show that interface. Short on purpose.
player_gamepad_ui_mode_connected: Option of Show it: only while a controller is attached.
player_gamepad_ui_mode_hint: 'it' is the controller interface; Always is the option name.
player_follow_os_theme_hint: Desktop is the player's desktop environment; its theme is that desktop's color scheme.
player_ui_palette: Setting label: the color family of the console's animated background.
player_library_view_hint: Shelf and Grid are the option names.
player_library_sections_all: Value of Library sections when every section is on.
player_library_sections_some: Value of Library sections. {count}: sections shown; {total}: all sections there are.
player_library_sections_hint: Games is the name of the console's library tab.
player_reduce_ui_resolution_hint: Android TV and Samsung variant. 1080p and 4K are video formats; keep them.
player_resolution_native: Option of Resolution: the display's own size, resolved when a stream starts.
player_resolution_native_size: Android: the Native option with the size it resolves to. {width}, {height}: pixels.
player_resolution_native_hint: Linux: shown while Native display is picked.
player_resolution_native_safe_area: Android option: the display's size minus the camera cutout.
player_resolution_native_safe_area_size: Android: the safe-area option with its size. {width}, {height}: pixels.
player_resolution_match_window: Option of Resolution (or a switch on Apple): the stream follows the window's size through every resize.
player_resolution_match_window_hint: Linux: shown while Match window is picked.
player_resolution_custom: Last option of Resolution: shows fields to type a width and height.
player_resolution_custom_size: A typed resolution no list holds. {width}, {height}: pixels.
player_resolution_custom_row: Row label (Apple TV, browser) for typing a width and height.
player_resolution_aspect: Row label above Resolution: picks which family of sizes (16:9, 21:9, …) the Resolution list offers.
player_resolution_aspect_hint: 'Resolution' is the name of the row below; keep it equal to player_resolution.
player_resolution_aspect_screen: Aspect ratio entry: this device's own screen shape, when no standard ratio fits it.
player_resolution_aspect_safe_area: Aspect ratio entry: this device's screen minus its camera cutout.
player_refresh_hz_native: Option of Refresh rate: the display's own rate.
player_refresh_hz_native_rate: Android: the Native option with the rate it resolves to. {hz}: whole hertz.
player_bitrate_kbps_automatic: Option of Bitrate: the rate adapts on its own.
player_bitrate_kbps_fixed: Option of Bitrate under the PyroWave codec: always the rate the quality needs.
player_bitrate_kbps_custom: Last option of Bitrate: opens a field to type a rate.
player_bitrate_kbps_custom_value: A typed bitrate no list holds. {value}: the rate with its unit, already formatted ("14 Mbit/s").
player_bitrate_kbps_hint: List control (console, Android, Apple TV). Automatic is the option name.
player_bitrate_kbps_pyrowave_hint: Shown under Bitrate while the codec is PyroWave. Automatic and Fixed are the option names.
player_bitrate_kbps_auto_switch: A switch (Mac, iPhone, iPad, browser): on means the rate adapts on its own.
player_bitrate_kbps_pyrowave_switch_hint: Apple, under the Automatic bitrate switch while the codec is PyroWave. 'off' is the switch's state.
player_bitrate_kbps_entry: Label of the field where a fixed bitrate is typed.
player_pyrowave_bpp: Setting label. PyroWave is a codec name; keep it.
player_pyrowave_bpp_rate: What the PyroWave quality needs for the picture the host encodes. {width}, {height}: its pixels; {hz}: whole hertz; {rate}: formatted rate with unit ("1.3 Gbit/s").
player_pyrowave_bpp_wifi_warning: Warning under PyroWave quality when this device is on Wi-Fi.
player_pyrowave_bpp_port_warning: Warning under PyroWave quality. {need}: the rate the quality needs; {port}: what this device's Ethernet port carries. Both formatted with unit.
player_pyrowave_bpp_gbe_warning: Warning under PyroWave quality when the port speed is unknown. {need}: the rate needed, formatted with unit. GbE = gigabit Ethernet.
player_video_fit: Setting label: how the picture fills the screen when the shapes differ.
player_video_fit_hint: Hint under the video fit setting; each option has its own hint.
player_video_fit_fit_hint: Linux: shown while Fit is picked.
player_video_fit_crop_hint: Linux: shown while Crop to fill is picked.
player_video_fit_stretch_hint: Linux: shown while Stretch to fill is picked.
player_screens: Setting label: one monitor, or a host screen on every monitor.
player_screens_hint: All monitors is the option name.
player_screens_this_hint: Linux: shown while This monitor is picked.
player_screens_all_hint: Linux: shown while All monitors is picked.
player_second_screen_hint: Android. The companion panel is a side panel the app shows on a second screen.
player_hdr_enabled_hint: HDR10 and HDR are format names; keep them.
player_present_priority: Setting label: what the presenter favors. Its options are Lowest latency and Smoothness.
player_present_priority_hint: Lowest latency and Smoothness are the option names.
player_present_priority_latency_hint: Linux: shown while Lowest latency is picked.
player_present_priority_smooth_hint: Linux: shown while Smoothness is picked.
player_smooth_buffer: Setting label: how many frames the Smoothness option holds back.
player_smooth_buffer_frames: Option of Smoothness buffer. {count}: frames held back (1 to 3).
player_smooth_buffer_frames_cost: Option of Smoothness buffer with its added delay. {count}: frames (1 to 3); {ms}: milliseconds, whole number.
player_render_scale: Setting label: the host renders larger or smaller than the stream, and the host or this device resamples.
player_render_scale_supersample: Option of Render scale above 1×. {scale}: the multiplier, formatted ("1.5", "2").
player_render_scale_custom_value: A typed render scale no list holds. {value}: the scale as the client shows it ("130 %" or "1.3×").
player_render_scale_percent: Field label: render scale as a whole percent.
player_render_scale_entry: Title of the field where a render scale is typed, as a percent.
player_codec_auto: Option of Video codec: the host picks.
player_codec_pyrowave: Option of Video codec. PyroWave is a codec name; 'wired LAN' says it needs a cable.
player_codec_av1_unsupported: Video codec value when the stored choice is AV1 and this device can't decode it.
player_codec_pyrowave_unsupported: Video codec value when the stored choice is PyroWave and this device can't decode it.
player_codec_pyrowave_hint: Linux: shown while PyroWave is picked.
player_enable_444: Setting label. 4:4:4 is a chroma format; keep it.
player_vsync_hint: Hint under V-Sync. The label V-Sync is a product term and is not translated.
player_allow_vrr_hint: Hint under the variable refresh rate (VRR) switch.
player_compositor: Setting label: which Linux compositor a host uses for its virtual output.
player_decoder_software: Option of Video decoder: decode on the CPU.
player_screen: Vision Pro setting label: a flat or curved virtual screen.
player_screen_flat: Option of Screen. The other options (4000R … 800R) are curvature radii and stay as written.
prefs_category_quick_actions: The Quick actions category of the settings sidebar (Windows, Apple TV).
prefs_advanced: Heading over a category's advanced settings.
player_mic_enabled_keys_hint: Second line of the microphone hint. keys is the mute chord from the client's shortcut table, e.g. Ctrl+Alt+Shift+V or ⌃⌥⇧V.
player_mouse_mode_keys_hint: Second line of the mouse input hint. keys is the mouse-mode chord from the client's shortcut table, e.g. Ctrl+Alt+Shift+M or ⌃⌥⇧M.
player_inhibit_shortcuts_hint: keys lists the system shortcuts this client captures, from its shortcut table, e.g. Alt+Tab, Super, … or ⌘Space, ⌘Tab.
player_cursor_gestures_hint: TV remote setting. button is the remote's confirm key the client names, e.g. OK.
player_guide_gesture_hint: button is the controller's Select/View/Share button as the client names it.
about_stream_controls: Row in About that opens the keys, controller chords and gestures that work in a stream.
about_licenses: Row in About that opens the licenses screen.
about_license_statement: First line of the licenses screen. MIT OR Apache-2.0 is an SPDX expression: keep it as written.
preset_new: Entry that creates a preset: last row of the Presets tab, last item of the preset chooser.
preset_new_title: Title of the dialog or screen that names a new preset.
preset_rename_title: Title of the dialog or screen that renames a preset.
preset_name: Label of a preset's name field.
preset_name_placeholder: Placeholder in the empty name field.
preset_name_taken: Shown when the typed name is taken (any case). name is the typed name.
prefs_group_touch_pointer: Group heading on the Input page.
prefs_group_keyboard_mouse: Group heading on the Input page.
prefs_applies_next_session: Note under the Audio and Controllers settings.
player_touch_mode_trackpad_hint: Caption while Touch input is Trackpad.
player_touch_mode_pointer_hint: Caption while Touch input is Direct pointer.
player_touch_mode_touch_hint: Caption while Touch input is Touch passthrough.
player_touch_mode_off_hint: Caption while Touch input is Off.
player_mouse_mode_capture_hint: Caption while Mouse input is Capture.
player_mouse_mode_desktop_hint: Caption while Mouse input is Desktop.
player_speaker_device: Device-only row: which output plays the host's audio.
player_speaker_device_hint: System default is the first option of this row.
player_speaker_device_system: First option of the Speaker row: follow the OS output.
player_speaker_device_missing: A saved speaker that is not connected now. name is the device's name.
player_mic_device: Device-only row: which input feeds the host's virtual mic.
player_mic_device_system: First option of the Microphone row: follow the OS input.
player_mic_device_missing: A saved microphone that is not connected now. name is the device's name.
pad_none_detected: The controller list in settings when no pad is connected.
prefs_scope_defaults: The settings layer every preset inherits from, as named in the preset chooser.
prefs_scope_editing: Label of the chooser that picks which layer the settings edit: Default settings or a preset.
preset_color: Label of a preset's color picker.
preset_menu_delete: Menu item or button: delete the preset, after a confirmation.
preset_delete_hosts: Delete confirmation; count is how many hosts use this preset as their default. Shown only when count > 0.
preset_delete_cards: Delete confirmation; count is how many host cards show this preset. Shown only when count > 0.
preset_color_none: Swatch that leaves the preset uncolored: its chip takes the theme's accent.
prefs_override_reset_full: Tooltip, accessibility label or context-menu item of an overridden row's reset.
prefs_overridden: Marker on a settings row the edited preset overrides.
prefs_override_help: Tooltip of an overridden row's marker and reset.
preset_edit_title: Title of the sheet or dialog that edits a preset's name and color.
preset_menu_edit_named: Menu item in the preset chooser: edit the selected preset. name is the preset's name.
about_version_line: Under the app name on the About page. version is the app's version string.
prefs_scope_preset_hint: Caption under the preset chooser while a preset is selected. name is the preset's name.
preset_delete_named_title: Title of the delete confirmation. name is the preset's name.
preset_delete_unused: Delete confirmation when no host uses the preset and no card shows it.
preset_copy_name: Name a duplicated preset starts with; stored as its name. name is the original's name.
preset_copy_name_numbered: Name a duplicated preset starts with when '{name} copy' is taken; stored. n counts from 2.
preset_new_hint: Under the name field while creating a preset.
about_docs: About page link to the documentation site.
about_source: About page link to the source repository.
about_notices_unavailable: Licenses screen when the bundled notices file can't be read.
pad_player_number: Badge on a forwarded controller: its player slot. n starts at 1.
about_third_party_heading: Heading over the third-party notices an app bundles, on the licenses screen.
about_licenses_title: Title of the screen listing the licenses of bundled third-party software.
overlay_players: First stats-overlay line: which controller slot(s) this session is. count = how many players; players = their numbers joined with ' · ', e.g. '1 · 2'.
overlay_screen: Statistics overlay label before the monitor's label.
overlay_lost: Stats overlay field. value = lost frames as the code formats it: '1.2%', '3', or '3 (1.2%)'.
overlay_host_override: Stats overlay field after the preset's name: the host set this game's resolution, refresh rate, HDR or controller. Lowercase like the other fields.
overlay_host_renders: Stats overlay field after the stream's size, when the host renders larger and scales the picture down before sending it. width, height = the host's size in pixels. Lowercase like the other fields.
overlay_received: Stats overlay field. value = frame rate as formatted, e.g. '60 fps'.
overlay_decoded: Stats overlay field. value = decoded frames per second, a bare number, e.g. '60'.
overlay_presented: Stats overlay field. value = presented frames per second, a bare number, e.g. '60'.
overlay_host: Stats overlay field: time the host spent on a frame. value = milliseconds as formatted, '4.1 ms' or bare '4.1' inside the sum line.
overlay_network: Stats overlay field inside the latency sum. value = milliseconds, a bare number, e.g. '2.3'.
overlay_host_network: Stats overlay field inside the latency sum when the two cannot be split. value = milliseconds, a bare number.
overlay_decode: Stats overlay field: decode time. value = milliseconds, '3.2 ms' or bare '3.2' inside the sum line.
overlay_display: Stats overlay field: time from decoded to shown. value = milliseconds, '5.0 ms' or bare '5.0' plus a breakdown in parentheses.
overlay_pace: Stats overlay field inside the display breakdown (Advanced statistics). value = milliseconds, a bare number.
overlay_latch: Stats overlay field inside the display breakdown (Advanced statistics): the swapchain latch. value = milliseconds, a bare number.
overlay_os_floor: Stats overlay field inside the display breakdown (Advanced statistics): the compositor's own share. value = milliseconds, a bare number.
overlay_avg_tag: Stats overlay: appended to the line of average stage times, e.g. 'host 4.1 ms · decode 3.2 ms (avg)'.
overlay_target: Stats overlay field: the bitrate asked of the host. value = e.g. '40 Mb/s'.
overlay_target_auto: Stats overlay field while Automatic bitrate sets the target. value = e.g. '40 Mb/s'.
overlay_audio_lossless: Stats overlay line for lossless audio. rate = sample rate with unit, e.g. '48 kHz'; bits = bit depth number, e.g. '24'.
overlay_audio_buffer: Stats overlay line. value = buffer length, e.g. '40 ms'.
overlay_av_offset: Stats overlay field after the audio buffer: audio/video offset. value = signed milliseconds, e.g. '+12 ms'.
overlay_mic: Stats overlay line: microphone frames sent. value = e.g. '50 f/s'.
overlay_mic_dropped: Stats overlay field after the mic rate: microphone frames dropped in this window. count = a number.
overlay_end_to_end: Advanced stats headline field. value = median latency, e.g. '18.2 ms'. 'p50' is the median and stays as is.
overlay_capture_to_received: Advanced stats headline field: where the measured interval ends.
overlay_capture_to_decoded: Advanced stats headline field: where the measured interval ends.
overlay_capture_to_displayed: Advanced stats headline field: where the measured interval ends.
overlay_capture_to_on_glass: Advanced stats headline field: the interval ends when the frame is lit on the panel.
overlay_same_host_clock: Advanced stats: appended to the headline when client and host share one clock.
overlay_decode_inside_display: Advanced stats line when decode overlaps display. value = e.g. '3.2 ms'; count = samples in the window.
overlay_host_stages: Advanced stats line: the host's stages. Each placeholder is milliseconds, a bare number like '1.2'.
overlay_os_present_excluded: Advanced stats line. value = milliseconds, a bare number like '8.3'.
overlay_rtt: Stats overlay field: network round trip. value = e.g. '2.1 ms'.
overlay_clock_suspect: Advanced stats warning line. rate = samples per second, a whole number.
overlay_skipped: Stats overlay field: frames not shown. value = a count '4' or a share '1.2%'.
overlay_skipped_overflow: Stats overlay field. count = frames skipped; overflow = of those, skipped because a queue overflowed.
overlay_rate_cut_loss: Stats overlay warning field: why Automatic bitrate last cut the rate.
overlay_rate_cut_repairs: Stats overlay warning field: the decoder kept asking for keyframes.
overlay_rate_cut_decoder: Stats overlay warning field: frames took longer to decode.
overlay_rate_cut_encoder: Stats overlay warning field: the host took longer to encode.
overlay_rate_cut_delay: Stats overlay warning field: packets arrived later.
overlay_loss_repairs: Stats overlay field after the bitrate-lowered reason. rate = repairs in the last minute, a whole number.
overlay_host_min_max: Detailed stats field. min, max = milliseconds, bare numbers.
overlay_display_split_compositor: Detailed stats field. Each placeholder is milliseconds, a bare number.
overlay_display_split: Detailed stats field. queue, render = milliseconds, bare numbers.
overlay_hdr_raw: Stats overlay field: an HDR stream shown on an SDR screen without tone mapping.
overlay_link_ports: Detailed stats line: the link every frame is paced at, from both ends' network ports. rate = e.g. '1 Gbit/s'; host_port, device_port = e.g. '2.5 GbE' or '100 Mbit/s Ethernet'.
overlay_link_measured_wifi: Detailed stats line. rate = e.g. '300 Mbit/s'.
overlay_link_measured: Detailed stats line. rate = e.g. '300 Mbit/s'.
overlay_link_unmeasured: Detailed stats line. rate = the floor it starts from, e.g. '20 Mbit/s'.
overlay_link_wake_shape: Appended to the Link line with ' · ' while the host paces for a lossy receiver.
overlay_link_small_buffer: Appended to the Link line on Linux while the socket drops packets. size = kilobytes. net.core.rmem_max is a system setting name: keep it.
overlay_pyrowave_floor: Stats overlay warning line. bpp = bits per pixel, a number; rate = megabits per second, a whole number.
notice_audio_muted_host_and_device: Badge over the stream, and the stream-mute slot's state in quick actions.
notice_audio_muted_host: Badge over the stream while the host operator muted this session's audio.
notice_audio_muted_device: Badge over the stream for a few seconds after the player muted the speakers.
notice_mic_muted: Pill over the stream for a few seconds after the player muted the microphone.
notice_mic_live: Pill over the stream for a few seconds after the player opened the microphone.
grant_level_full: This device's access level on the host, shown on the in-stream chip. Same words as the web console's access_level_full.
grant_level_controller: Access level: only controller input reaches the host.
grant_level_view: Access level: the stream shows, no input reaches the host.
grant_level_custom: Access level: a grant set that is none of the three presets.
grant_chip_ends: In-stream access chip, after the level and ' · '. time = remaining time from grant_remaining_hours_minutes / _hours / _minutes / _seconds, e.g. '1 h 58 m'.
grant_chip_ends_soon: In-stream access chip, after the level and ' · ', in the last minute.
grant_remaining_minutes: Remaining access time. minutes = whole minutes, 1 to 59.
grant_remaining_hours: Remaining access time on the hour. hours = whole hours.
grant_remaining_hours_minutes: Remaining access time. hours = whole hours; minutes = 1 to 59.
grant_now_full: Toast mid-stream when the host changed this device's access.
grant_now_controller: Toast mid-stream when the host changed this device's access.
grant_now_view: Toast mid-stream when the host changed this device's access.
grant_now_custom: Toast mid-stream when the host changed this device's access to a custom set.
grant_ends_in: Toast or badge mid-stream: the host's 5-minute warning. time = e.g. '5 m', from grant_remaining_*.
notice_reconnecting: Status while the client redials a dropped stream on its own.
notice_host_not_ready_retry: Status while the client waits for a waking host and dials again.
notice_codec_fallback: Toast while the client reconnects without a codec its decoder gave up on. codec = codec name, e.g. 'HEVC'.
notice_touch_unsupported: Pill at stream start when touch passthrough is set but the host cannot inject touch.
notice_capture_click: Hint over a desktop stream window (Linux, Windows, Mac) until input is captured.
notice_exit_hold: Banner at stream start, and a capture-hint field. keys = the controller chord, e.g. 'L1 + R1 + Start + Select'.
notice_exit_keys: Banner at stream start without a controller. keys = the keyboard shortcut, e.g. 'Ctrl+Alt+Shift+D'.
notice_resizing: Over the stream while the host changes the stream's resolution mid-session.
grant_ends_soon: Toast or badge mid-stream: the host's 1-minute warning.
grant_remaining_seconds: Remaining access time below a minute (Apple, Android). seconds = whole seconds.
pad_title: Title of the Controllers screen (console tab, Android screen headline).
pad_kind_joycon_pair: What a pad streams as: two Joy-Con halves combined. 'Joy-Con' is a product name.
pad_sc2_bluetooth: Row naming the Bluetooth access grant for a Steam Controller 2 (Android only).
pad_sc2_bluetooth_detail: Explains the Bluetooth grant for a Steam Controller 2 (Android only). 'Puck' is the dongle's product name.
pad_test_last_input: Under the controller input test. input = a raw readout with no words, e.g. 'LX +0.52' or 'Pad: scan 0x130 · BUTTON_A'.
about_notices_loading: Licenses screen while the platform's notice file loads.
notice_ring_opens_keys: Exit-hint banner at stream start when no controller is in hand. keys = the key or button that opens them, e.g. 'Back' or 'Ctrl+Alt+Shift+O'.
notice_ring_twist: Exit-hint banner at stream start on a touch screen.
notice_ring_edge_pull: Exit-hint banner at stream start when touches go to the host as real touches.
notice_motion_unreachable: Badge at stream start when a pad's gyro cannot reach the host's virtual controller. 'Controller type' is the setting's label (player_gamepad).
notice_exit_arming: Cue over the stream while the controller's leave chord is held, before it fires.
notice_pin_unsustainable: Toast once per stream when a fixed bitrate overruns this device. rate = megabits per second, a whole number. 'Automatic' is the Bitrate setting's option (player_bitrate_kbps_automatic).
notice_shared_screen: Toast once at stream start when this device joins a screen another device opened (Play together).
notice_falling_behind: Toast once per stream after five seconds of skipped frames. width, height = the stream's size in pixels.
hosts_error_name_empty: Toast when the host page's Name row is applied empty.
